full_judgment:
2. The present petitioner filed the said writ-petition before the High Court Division challenging the order No. 42 dated 23.07.2009 passed by the Artha Rin Adalat, Mymensingh in Artha Decree Execution Case No. 19 of 2007 issuing warrant of arrest against the judgment-debtor-petitioner. 

 6. From the very impugned order in appears that on the prayer of this judgment-debtor-leave-petitioner the executing court earlier re-called the warrant of arrest more than once for enabling him to pay the decretal amount, but inspite of that the judgment-debtor-leave-petitioner did not pay the decretal amount. In the circumstances, on the prayer of the decree-holder bank, the executing court issued warrant of arrest against this judgment-debtor-leave-petitioner again by the impugned order.
